enabled.description: Enable or disable the mDNS reflector service.

interfaces.description: List of network interface names between which mDNS traffic should be reflected. Usually includes at least one wired and one wireless interface.

record_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for reflected mDNS records. Controls how long reflected entries remain valid.

max_queries_per_second.description: Maximum number of mDNS queries per second to reflect. Helps prevent reflection storms.

max_reflected_entries.description: Maximum number of simultaneous mDNS entries (hosts, services) to track and reflect. Prevents memory exhaustion on large networks.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Choose from: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical.

log_file.description: Path to a dedicated log file, or leave empty / set to 'syslog' to use the system logger.
